description: A round glass vase contains a bouquet of yellow, blue, and white pansies with dark centers. The vase rests on a light surface alongside three additional pansies. The brightly colored flowers contrast with the light blue, yellow, and pink tones of the plain background.
title: Untitled (Pansies)
